description: Recall corpus for the FIS Benchmark. Intentionally-vulnerable, publicly-documented training apps (OWASP & friends). These SHOULD audit RED — the right verdict is high_risk or not_safe and the right critical-finding count is > 0. A known-vulnerable app that FIS verdicts green (production_ready / ready_with_conditions) is a MISS (recall gap). Detection rate = fraction verdicted not-green.
removed_entry_note: bkimminich/juice-shop-ctf was removed after the first run — it is a CTF helper tool that generates challenges, NOT a vulnerable app, so FIS correctly passing it was a corpus-labeling error, not a recall miss. On the 11 genuinely-vulnerable apps, detection was 100% (run 2026-06-30, mean 3.17 criticals/app).
metric: detection_rate = repos verdicted high_risk|not_safe / total. miss = a known-vuln app verdicted green. Also track mean critical findings per app.
